title: 直壁岩包站姿
description: 粉彩描绘低岩包上的稳定站姿，下一只手点离身体很近。

art_direction.medium: editorial geometric illustration with credible adult proportions
art_direction.scene: An original pastel illustration shows a fictional adult standing securely on a low broad volume attached to a vertical bouldering wall. One shoe presses a positive ledge on the volume and the other remains on a visible foothold beside it; large mint handholds sit within a comfortable reach. The climber shifts the hips over the front leg and prepares a short next hand movement. Frame the entire figure from a side-oblique wide angle with thick continuous crash mats and a clear landing area. Use soft coral pigments, deep green clothing, and chalky cream wall texture. Maintain adult proportions. No jumping, lettering, brands, narrow high ledges, or exposed climbing.
